env.//: WHERE THE TOOL CACHES LIVE — declared here so devbox is the single source of truth, and CI does not have to ask each tool at runtime. The layout is then identical on a laptop and on a runner, and .github/workflows/ci.yml caches these paths by name instead of resolving them.
env.//cargo: CARGO_HOME moves the registry (414 MB) and git checkouts into the repo. Note it also becomes where `cargo install` puts binaries: anything already in ~/.cargo/bin keeps working and stays on PATH, but new installs made inside this project land in .devbox/cache/cargo/bin and will not be.
env.//npm: npm reads npm_config_cache; NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX below is a different thing (where -g packages go).
env.//playwright: Declared rather than defaulted, so the browser download and the CI cache agree by construction.
env.//tinygo: TINYGO IS NOT HERE, AND IT CANNOT BE. It takes its cache from Go's os.UserCacheDir() and ignores GOCACHE and XDG_CACHE_HOME — verified, not assumed: `GOCACHE=/tmp/x tinygo env GOCACHE` still answers ~/Library/Caches/tinygo. So it stays global and CI resolves it with `tinygo env GOCACHE`, which is the one query the workflow still makes.

init_hook: rustup show >/dev/null 2>&1 || rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
